ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

Leaders.helper: Add at least one leaders item. You can add more items as needed.

FullName.helper: Enter the person's first and last name.

CompanyName.helper: Enter the company name to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Title.helper: Enter the title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Image.helper: Choose the image or file to use for image. Use a clear file that fits this content.

Email.helper: Enter the email address to use for email.

MemberPage.helper: Enter the web address for member page. You can use a page on this site or another website.
